subject: Post-discovery: lock 60-90min ML/Infra runthrough and draft agenda
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <slopez@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock 60-90min ML/Infra runthrough and draft agenda

Hi Samantha — great speaking earlier today. Appreciate you walking us through the current infra and latency goals. As discussed, the next step is a focused technical runthrough with your ML and infra leads so we can:

- Validate runtime characteristics on your workloads (latency & token throughput)
- Walk through routing/cache/batching tradeoffs that impact unit cost
- Review security/network integration (VPC, KMS, data flows)
- Agree on a mutual action plan and success criteria for an initial pilot

Proposed session: 60–90 minutes, remote, hands-on Q&A with our ML infra engineers. Suggested slots next week (all PT):
- Wed 2028-04-04 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu 2028-04-05 10:00–11:30 PT
- Fri 2028-04-06 15:00–16:30 PT

Please let us know which of the above works (or propose alternatives). We’ll bring: Karthik (ops/serving runtime), Marissa (model-serving lead), and one systems engineer. If you can also include your infra and ML owners (we heard you mention Daniel), we’ll make the agenda tighter.

Prep attachments: I’ve attached a short precall deck with sample agendas and questions. If you have a short corpus or perf target numbers you’d like us to use in the session, you can share ahead of time.

Next steps: confirm a slot, share attendee list + any high priority topics (SSO, audit logs, retention), and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood-tdx-precall-deck.pdf (12 pages)
From: Samantha Lopez <slopez@novamed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 08:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock 60-90min ML/Infra runthrough and draft agenda

Thanks Priyom — this looks perfect. I’d like to include our infra lead Daniel Kim (cc’d) and one of our ML engineers (I’ll confirm the name tomorrow). Primary goals for us: validate tail latency at 1M tokens/day, and confirm isolation/retention controls for PHI-adjacent logs.

Of your proposed times, Wed 4/4 afternoon works best for us (we’re on Eastern). Would 17:00–18:30 ET work on your end? If not, Thu morning ET is our fallback.

Also: one ask — can you include a short blurb in the session that covers how fallbacks work if a dedicated pool is saturated? That was a point of interest for our platform team.

Samantha Lopez
Director, Platform Engineering | NovaMed
samantha.lopez@novamed.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <slopez@novamed.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novamed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock 60-90min ML/Infra runthrough and draft agenda

Samantha — thanks, Wed works. 17:00 ET is 14:00 PT, so let’s lock 2028-04-04 14:00–15:30 PT / 17:00–18:30 ET. I sent a calendar hold via Cal.com (link below) — feel free to accept and I’ll add the invite with dial-in and materials.

Quick updates for the agenda per your notes:
- Perf targets & tail latency validation (we’ll run a few synthetic traces + discuss measurement points)
- Isolation, retention, and audit logs (Marissa will cover retention/SOC2 considerations)
- Routing and graceful degradation (how dedicated pools, fallbacks to hosted variants, and region routing behave)
- Next steps & pilot success criteria

I’ve also attached our security-readme that covers SOC2 scope, encryption in transit/at rest, and KMS integrations — Daniel, if you could share any SOC2 contacts or specific audit evidence requests ahead of the call, Marissa can prep targeted slides.

Calendar: https://cal.com/priyom/60
Attachments: security-readme-2028.pdf

See you all on the 4th.

— Priyom
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lopez <slopez@novamed.com>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock 60-90min ML/Infra runthrough and draft agenda

Quick note from the infra side — I’ll bring a short notebook that demonstrates: continuous batching behavior, KV-cache warmup, and a fallback flow where we route to a quantized variant with slightly different latency/cost characteristics. Marissa — can you add the retention + audit slide we discussed? Priyom — I’ll sync with Marcus Lin to grab a short script we can run against a small sample to illustrate tail latency.

Thanks everyone — we’ll aim to circulate pre-read (deck + short perf script) 48 hours before the call.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kar thik.iyer@redwood.com
